videos.t: How to make running harder
videos.desc:
My brother and I made the terrible decision to run a Spartan Race this weekend! We got muddy, fell off the monkey bars, and had an amazing time together! 
While these races are difficult, I think that almost anyone can tough it out and cross the finish line. More than that, it's an amazing feeling of accomplishment when you finally get that medal. 
Aroo!

videos.desc:
Check out my referal link on PCB way to help support the channel https://pcbway.com/g/CSGCfy

Idk if I need to mention this, but Red Bull as a company officially had nothing to do with this project. I'm not representing them in any way. I just thought this would be fun to try to do.
